overview_description.description: Perl Street is the fintech platform for distributed energy resources (DERs) such as rooftop solar, energy storage, electric vehicle (EV) chargers, and heat pumps for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. It enables DER asset investors and managers to bundle and aggregate DER assets, originate bankable portfolios, and manage more assets with higher margins. Leveraging AI agents and modern data architecture, the platform consolidates and normalizes DER assets into portfolios, enabling scalability, performance, and compliance. Perl Street has 1GW+ DER assets on its platform across 1,100 DER assets.
